title: Long-Run Property Market Trends in New Zealand and Australia
summary: Where are NZ house prices heading over the next five years? An evidence-based look at long-run data, credit conditions, and what happened in similar countries.

title: Tax Optimisation for New Zealand SMEs and Their Owners
summary: A practical, officially sourced guide to legitimate tax optimisation for New Zealand small and medium enterprises and their owners. Covers entity choice, the personal and company rate scales, GST and provisional tax, deductions including the 2025 Investment Boost, FBT and KiwiSaver, investment income, property settings, the R&D Tax Incentive, and the anti-avoidance boundary. All figures sourced from IRD, the Income Tax Act 2007, and official Budget material for the 2025/26 and 2026/27 years.

title: NZ First-Home Buyers and the Property Market: Testing the Common Assumptions
summary: Who is buying homes in New Zealand, and what really drives prices? This brief tests common beliefs against official data. Covers first-home buyers, overseas buyers, regional price gaps, interest rates, migration, and building supply.

title: Why I Bought a Lotto Ticket This Week (Despite Knowing the Maths)
summary: Wednesday's Powerball sits at $35 million. The published odds are 1 in 38.4 million. I bought a ticket anyway. Here is the logic, and it is not as irrational as it sounds. A journey through conditional probability, Taleb's barbell strategy, anticipatory utility, and the strategic thinking gym.
